title: Creative Prompt AI: a desktop app for open-source text-to-image models
summary: An open-source desktop interface for generating images with Hugging Face text-to-image models, with LoRA support, batch generation and a built-in viewer.

title: LOCC Mapper: measuring and mapping a codebase
summary: A small open-source tool that counts lines of code per file type and visualizes how the files in a codebase are connected.

title: A pitch estimator in the browser
summary: A web demo that listens to the microphone and estimates the fundamental frequency of a sound in real time, using the CREPE neural network.

title: Code release: acoustic reflector localization on a robot (IROS 2020)
summary: MATLAB code and hardware details for our IROS 2020 paper, which locates walls and glass surfaces with a single microphone and loudspeaker.

title: Welcome to Bitbytelab
summary: An introduction to this blog, where I share my work on robotics and signal processing.
